message.content: Repo /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper. Fix PR #453 (Dependabot group bump 'routine-npm', branch `dependabot/npm_and_yarn/routine-npm-7a91df9ab8`, base main): it bumps @chakra-ui/react 3.37.0->3.38.0, oxfmt 0.76.0->0.77.0, oxlint 1.90.0->1.92.0, @napi-rs/cli 3.10.11->3.10.12, @storybook/react and storybook 11.0.0-alpha.9->11.0.0-beta.0, vite 8.3.5->8.3.6 (package.json, packages/{napi,storybook,vite-plugin}/package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml). CI fails: the `Lint` job (`just lint doc-check machete typos`) errors in oxlint 1.92: `apps/oracle/src/caliper-input.ts:19:55: Prefer throwing a TypeError over a generic Error after a type checking if-statement`; the `CI` aggregate fails because of it. Check out the branch in your worktree: `git fetch origin && git checkout -B fix/routine-npm-bump origin/dependabot/npm_and_yarn/routine-npm-7a91df9ab8`, merge origin/main into it (signed merge commit, no rebase/force-push: Dependabot may rebase its own branch later; that is fine), then fix everything the bumps broke, on TOP of the branch, and push with `git push origin HEAD:dependabot/npm_and_yarn/routine-npm-7a91df9ab8` (normal push, never --no-verify; if the push is refused as non-fast-forward because Dependabot moved the branch, fetch, merge again, retry; do not force-push). Steps: (1) fix the oxlint error by the rule's intent (throw TypeError where a type check precedes the throw), then run `just lint doc-check machete typos` and fix every further finding from oxlint 1.92 / oxfmt 0.77 (run `pnpm exec oxfmt` formatting where the check says so; do not disable rules or add ignores unless a rule is clearly wrong for this repo, and say so); (2) the Storybook alpha.9 -> beta.0 bump may break the addon (packages/storybook: preset/provider/session/index, its tests, the integration test and any Storybook-version-specific code or docs mentioning alpha.9): run `just test-ts`, `just test-napi`, `just test-integration` and fix real breakage minimally; if beta.0 changes a public API the addon relies on, report exactly what changed (and keep the fix small); another worker is changing packages/storybook (live upgrade) so keep hunks minimal and avoid refactors; (3) Chakra 3.38.0 may change the construct suite's or oracle goldens/fixtures that import it (grep apps/oracle and fixtures for @chakra-ui/react): run `pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-oracle construct:check` and `construct:parity` (free; NO `scripts/weekly.py --oracle`, no corpus fetches) and explain any golden differences (do not blindly re-capture goldens: say what changed and why, and re-capture only if the new Chakra legitimately changed types); (4) `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` must pass; check `pnpm-lock.yaml` consistency; `just machete` (if a bump orphans a dependency); `just test-rust` only if Rust-facing files changed (they should not). Use `pnpm install --offline --frozen-lockfile` first if the store has the packages; otherwise run the normal install. Rust 1.99.1 toolchain first on PATH if you build Rust (/Users/gabe/.rustup/toolchains/1.99.1-aarch64-apple-darwin/bin; commits need MISE_RUST_VERSION=1.99.1 for the pre-commit hook), own CARGO_TARGET_DIR under ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/dependabot-fix/ (no /tmp), outside the sandbox where tests need it. Signed commits with trailer `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_013R2ytvK9B32ZaSUaSe6aAZ`. Do not open or edit the PR, do not poll CI. Final report <= 200 words: what broke and the fix (per package), gates run with exit codes, golden differences if any, SHAs, what was not verified.
